name: Nintendo Virtual Boy
significance: Nintendo's shortest-lived hardware venture, remembered as an eccentric precursor to modern virtual reality that explored true parallax stereoscopic 3D.

verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Dual oscillating mirror red LED display scanners (384x224)

editorialContent.overview: Gunpei Yokoi's tabletop red-monochrome stereoscopic 3D headset that projected virtual depth using oscillating mirror lines.
